model-agency.lead: The agency's adult division: the roster of models, work directions and casting requests. The agency updates content itself in the Tilda editor.

facts.v: Show models and collect casting requests
A Tilda store with a portfolio catalog

blocks.title: The starting point
blocks.p1: The model portfolio lived in messengers and social networks: selections were sent by hand, and casting requests got lost in chats.
blocks.p2: They needed a place that shows the agency roster and work directions and where both a client and a prospective model could be sent.

blocks.title: What was done
blocks.p1: The structure was built around two audiences: a client browses the model catalog and directions, an applicant lands on the casting request form.
blocks.p2: The portfolio catalog was built on Tilda so the agency could add new cards and change photos itself, without a developer.

blocks.title: The outcome
blocks.p1: Requests come through the form, and model selections are shared as a link to the site instead of a messenger archive.
blocks.p2: Updating the roster is no longer a job for a contractor — cards are edited in the Tilda editor in a couple of minutes.

tilda-translate.lead: A ru/en module for Tilda: a language switch, saved visitor choice and content translation without duplicating pages.

facts.v: A Tilda site with two languages

blocks.title: The starting point
blocks.p1: Tilda has no convenient bilingual support out of the box: usually you have to duplicate pages, which complicates maintenance.
blocks.p2: They needed a language switch that translates content and remembers the visitor's choice.

blocks.title: What was done
blocks.p1: I wrote a script that translates content on the fly and keeps the selected locale across pages.
blocks.p2: We avoided duplicating pages — the sources and code are open in a GitHub repository.

websites.meta-description: Websites for business: landing pages from RUB 50,000, Tilda stores and custom builds. I pick the right tool for the job, launch end to end and support after go-live.
websites.hero-lead: I build websites that work toward a result: clear structure, fast launch and easy content management — on Tilda you edit the site yourself, without a developer.
approach: I start with your goal, not a template. We figure out who your customers are, what they should do on the site and what outcome you need — sales, leads or awareness.

Then I pick the tool for the job and budget: sometimes a landing page is enough, sometimes you need a store with a catalog, and sometimes custom development. You get a tool that brings in leads, not just a pretty picture.
I stay in touch at every step: I show work-in-progress versions, explain decisions in plain language and leave you a site that's easy to manage without a developer.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: A landing page usually takes 1–2 weeks, a Tilda store — from 3 weeks, custom development — depending on the scope. We lock exact timing after the brief.

faq.question: What does the price depend on?
faq.answer: A landing page starts from RUB 50,000, a Tilda store from RUB 100,000, custom development is on request. The final amount depends on the number of pages and features — I quote the exact price after the brief.

faq.question: Can I edit the content myself?
faq.answer: It depends on the tool. On Tilda you change texts, products and prices yourself in the built-in editor — without reaching me. For custom sites we discuss editing options separately, tailored to the task.

faq.question: Do you help after launch?
faq.answer: Yes. I stay in touch: I make edits, improve things and advise on growing the site.

faq.question: Do I need my own domain and hosting?
faq.answer: I'll help choose and connect a domain. Hosting depends on the tool — I'll suggest the best option for your project.

faq.question: What's the fastest way to reach you?
faq.answer: Describe your task in the request form or message me directly on Telegram or WhatsApp — in messengers I usually reply within a day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy. Below is what personal data the site collects, why it is needed and how you can manage it.

sections.heading: 1. General provisions
paragraphs: This Policy governs how personal data of visitors to the sandwor website (the “Site”) is processed and protected, and is prepared in accordance with Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 “On Personal Data”.
The data operator is Alexander Olegovich Vorobyov (the “Operator”). Contact for personal-data matters: aovorobyov@mail.ru.
By using the Site and submitting data through its forms, you confirm your agreement with this Policy.

sections.heading: 2. What data is processed
paragraphs: When you fill in the forms on the Site, the Operator processes the data you provide voluntarily: name, email address, phone number, Telegram username, and the text of your message or task description.

When you visit the Site, technical data is processed automatically: IP address, cookies, browser and device information, and on-page activity. It is collected via the Yandex.Metrica web-analytics service.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: Personal data is processed in order to: handle requests submitted through the forms; contact you upon your request; and improve the Site and analyse its traffic.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: The basis for processing is the consent of the data subject. You give it by ticking the relevant checkbox when submitting a form or by continuing to use the Site with analytics enabled. Consent may be withdrawn at any time (see the section on rights).

sections.heading: 5. Manner and means of processing
paragraphs: Processing is carried out both with and without automation. Data submitted through the forms reaches the Operator as a message in the Telegram messenger and is used solely to contact you.
The Operator does not sell personal data and does not transfer it to third parties, except as described in this Policy or required by law.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and web analytics
paragraphs: The Site uses cookies and the Yandex.Metrica service (Yandex LLC, servers located in the Russian Federation) to analyse traffic. Metrica may collect your IP address, cookies, device data and on-site behaviour.

Analytics loads only after your consent in the cookie banner; if you decline, the counter is not loaded. You can withdraw consent by clearing site data in your browser or disabling cookies in its settings.

sections.heading: 7. Retention periods
paragraphs: Personal data is kept no longer than the purposes of processing require, or until consent is withdrawn. Once the purposes are achieved or consent is withdrawn, the data is deleted unless the law provides otherwise.

sections.heading: 8. Data protection
paragraphs: The Operator takes reasonable organisational and technical measures to protect personal data from unlawful access, alteration, disclosure and destruction.

sections.heading: 9. Rights of the data subject
paragraphs: You have the right to obtain information about the processing of your data, to request its correction, blocking or deletion, and to withdraw your consent. To exercise these rights, send a request to aovorobyov@mail.ru.

sections.heading: 10. Withdrawal of consent
paragraphs: You can withdraw consent to the processing of personal data by emailing aovorobyov@mail.ru. After withdrawal, the Operator stops processing and deletes the data unless there is another lawful basis to retain it.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to this Policy
paragraphs: The Operator may amend this Policy. The current version is always published on this page.

sections.heading: 12. Contacts
paragraphs: For any questions related to the processing of personal data, contact aovorobyov@mail.ru.
